notes: Beta: the app now comes back to the station you were actually working on instead of jumping to the main one every time it restarts — which was most noticeable right after an update. You can also rename a playlist (Tools → Rename); the songs, their play counts and any link to an online playlist all come with it. And a playlist can now follow a YouTube playlist as well as Spotify and Apple Music — YouTube is the most accurate of the three because it names the actual videos rather than titles the app has to go and search for, and if you make it collaborative anyone you share it with can add music to your station.
